say:2:1511246001:1.text: Tilaya, are you really going to leave the Wildborn tribe?
say:2:1511246001:1.source_cn: 缇洛亚，你真的决心要离开雅库伯尔了吗？

say:3:1511246002:1.text: Yes, I'm fed up with Kordan.
say:3:1511246002:1.source_cn: 当然，我早就看不惯戈丹。

say:4:1511246003:1.text: If I'd had any idea where to go or how to make it out of here... I would've taken Yohan and left this place seasons ago. But now, I finally do.
say:4:1511246003:1.source_cn: 要不是没有明确的目的地，不知道该怎么生存下去，我可能早...

say:5:1511246004:1.text: Thanks to <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we know that there really is a utopia out there. We just need to hit the road.
say:5:1511246004:1.male: Thanks to <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we know that there really is a utopia out there. We just need to hit the road.
say:5:1511246004:1.female: Thanks to <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we know that there really is a utopia out there. We just need to hit the road.

say:6:1511246005:0.text: Yes, but the only way to the Dark Forest is through the <style="highlight">Widowmaker's lair</style>.
say:6:1511246005:0.source_cn: 但前往薄暮丛林的必经之路上有<style=highli...

say:7:1511246006:1.text: With so many people following you... To lead them, you need to be prepared.
say:7:1511246006:1.source_cn: 还有这么多人和你一起……要带领大家，就得做好打算。

say:8:1511246007:1.text: However, don't worry. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I can use magic to help you...
say:8:1511246007:1.male: However, don't worry. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I can use magic to help you...
say:8:1511246007:1.female: However, don't worry. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I can use magic to help you...

say:9:1511246008:1.text: I always felt that spider was too close to us. That it'd be trouble one day.
say:9:1511246008:1.source_cn: 我之前一直在想，那家伙离雅库伯尔很近，总是个祸害。

say:11:1511246010:0.text: I have to face this thing alone. My strength must be the proof... proof that I can guide us to the Dark Forest. How can I ask for everyone's courage if I haven't shown my own?
say:11:1511246010:0.source_cn: 只有靠自己的力量战胜它，才能证明我有能力带领大家找到理...

say:12:1511246011:0.text: No matter what obstacles lie ahead, I know we can overcome them. As long as we stand together, there's nowhere we can't go...
say:12:1511246011:0.source_cn: 不管今后在路上遇到什么困难，都有人能克服它，只要大家一...

say:13:1511246012:0.text: Yes, this is the right path!

say:14:1511246013:1.text: Since you've already thought this through, I'll respect your decision.
say:14:1511246013:1.source_cn: ……既然你已经想清楚，我尊重你的选择。

say:15:1511246014:1.text: However, please allow Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and me to <style="highlight">accompany you along the way</style> so that I can feel a little more at ease.
say:15:1511246014:1.male: However, please allow Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and me to <style="highlight">accompany you along the way</style> so that I can feel a little more at ease.
say:15:1511246014:1.female: However, please allow Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and me to <style="highlight">accompany you along the way</style> so that I can feel a little more at ease.

say:16:1511246015:0.text: Weren't you going to join us anyway?
say:16:1511246015:0.source_cn: 送我们？你不和我们一起走吗？

say:18:1511246017:1.text: Just as you said, the Wildborn tribe is crumbling. I wish to save it.
say:18:1511246017:1.source_cn: 就像你说的那样，雅库伯尔已经是一棵腐朽的大树。但我想试...

say:19:1511246018:1.text: Thirteen years ago, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved our tribe. I cannot let our tribe disappear like this.
say:19:1511246018:1.male: Thirteen years ago, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved our tribe. I cannot let our tribe disappear like this.
say:19:1511246018:1.female: Thirteen years ago, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved our tribe. I cannot let our tribe disappear like this.

choice_prompt:20:1511246018.text: Thirteen years ago, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved our tribe. I cannot let our tribe disappear like this.
choice_prompt:20:1511246018.source_cn: 十三年前，是<style=stress><player_name></style>大人拯救了雅库伯尔，我不能让雅库伯尔就此消失。
choice_prompt:20:1511246018.male: Thirteen years ago, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved our tribe. I cannot let our tribe disappear like this.
choice_prompt:20:1511246018.female: Thirteen years ago, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved our tribe. I cannot let our tribe disappear like this.

say:22:1511246022:1.text: The tribe here is the soil of my soul. It was here I was blessed to meet Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and where my mind first opened to the world's wonders... I could never sever my roots from this sacred ground.
say:22:1511246022:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔是我的家乡，最初遇到<style=stress...
say:22:1511246022:1.male: The tribe here is the soil of my soul. It was here I was blessed to meet Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and where my mind first opened to the world's wonders... I could never sever my roots from this sacred ground.
say:22:1511246022:1.female: The tribe here is the soil of my soul. It was here I was blessed to meet Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> and where my mind first opened to the world's wonders... I could never sever my roots from this sacred ground.

say:23:1511246023:1.text: Tilaya, I promise I will not let the Wildborn perish like this. I will make the tribe better.
say:23:1511246023:1.source_cn: 缇洛亚，雅库伯尔不能就此消亡。但是它会变得更好，我保证。

say:24:1511246024:1.text: So... we're going to part ways?

say:25:1511246025:1.text: Yes, but not now. I still want to accompany you for a while.
say:25:1511246025:1.source_cn: 嗯，但不是现在，我还要陪你们一起走一程呢。

say:27:1511246027:1.text: I'll go inform the others. Everyone needs to get ready.
say:27:1511246027:1.source_cn: 我去通知其他人，大家需要做好准备。

say:28:1511246028:1.text: But let's take this journey slow.

narration:30:1511246030:0.text: Kordan and the warriors from Wrathwood Grove leave.
narration:30:1511246030:0.source_cn: 戈丹和树怒山谷的战士早已撤退

narration:31:1511246031:0.text: Tilaya shares her plan to rid the forest of the Widowmaker with her gathered band of Wildborn faithful, her words weaving a new future.
narration:31:1511246031:0.source_cn: 缇洛亚将清除巨蛛王的计划告知准备跟随她的雅库伯尔人

narration:33:1511246032:0.text: Mirehold turns into a hive of purposeful activity, more bustling than it had ever been. The Wildborn are readying their arms and packs.
narration:33:1511246032:0.source_cn: 水泽营地从未如此繁忙，雅库伯尔人纷纷收拾好行囊与武器

narration:35:1511246033:0.text: Tilaya takes the lead, with you and Gala close behind. You all push north, leaving the tree line behind, wading through shallow streams...
narration:35:1511246033:0.source_cn: 缇洛亚在前，你与加拉在后，你们一路向北，穿出树林，涉过溪水
narration:35:1511246033:0.male: Tilaya takes the lead, with you and Gala close behind. You all push north, leaving the tree line behind, wading through shallow streams...
narration:35:1511246033:0.female: Tilaya takes the lead, with you and Gala close behind. You all push north, leaving the tree line behind, wading through shallow streams...

narration:37:1511246034:0.text: ...until the very ground underfoot grows sticky with silken threads...
narration:37:1511246034:0.source_cn: 直至脚下开始有蛛网黏连……

choice:20:0:1.text: Actually, I don't care about the Wildborn.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 其实我不在乎雅库伯尔
choice:20:0:1.male: Actually, I don't care about the Wildborn.
choice:20:0:1.female: Actually, I don't care about the Wildborn.

say:39:1511246020:1.text: No need to persuade me. I've already made up my mind.
say:39:1511246020:1.source_cn: 您不必劝我，我已经下定决心了。
say:39:1511246020:1.male: No need to persuade me. I've already made up my mind.
say:39:1511246020:1.female: No need to persuade me. I've already made up my mind.

choice:20:1:2.text: Your own well-being is more important.
choice:20:1:2.male: Your own well-being is more important.
choice:20:1:2.female: Your own well-being is more important.

say:40:1511246021:1.text: With your words, I believe I will.
say:40:1511246021:1.source_cn: 有您这句话，我什么都能做到。
say:40:1511246021:1.male: With your words, I believe I will.
say:40:1511246021:1.female: With your words, I believe I will.
